verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a SaaS CRM, but the evidence pack contains nothing about data residency, region selection, or hosting locations. The closest item, ABAC access policies (salesforce-docs-32), covers who can see data, not where it is stored, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
